data.translation: Wenn diese Zeit gekommen war, dann gingen die Anwohner, d.h. die Leute, die vom Lärm betroffen waren, zur Polizei und sagten: Sie lassen uns wegen des Lärms keine Ruhe. Die Polizisten kamen und sagten zu uns: Ihr raubt den Leuten die Ruhe, wegen des Lärms eurer Arbeit können die Leute nicht einschlafen.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 1.6/10)

data.turoyo: Bəṯr məftakalli, umanno: "D l əbinala w howe mede rabo, gmaḥti u suǧano kule b qḏole da tretayna. Walaw huwena ḥaqli ste, i naqla d xusri, kul ḥa gdomər: "Flan kas we." I kayəstayḏa gəmšawrina b kulle, gmaltmina hol d kito, xd i kurmanǧiyayḏan komər, gasko maṣ ṣuroyayḏan gmaltmina hanək ste, mšawrina b kulle."
data.translation: Dann überlegte ich mir: Wenn wir sie nicht herausgeben und es entwickelt sich daraus eine größere Krise, dann wird man die ganze Schuld uns beiden anhängen. Selbst wenn wir im Recht sind, wenn sie verlieren, wird jeder sagen: Der und der war es. Am besten wir beraten es mit allen, wir versammeln alle unsere Christen bis hin zum Ziegenböckchen, wie unsere Kurden sagen, auch die versammeln wir und beraten uns mit allen.

rationale: Concessive personal state ḥaqli, fills Infectum 1 under clarified sein, werden.

data.translation: Eigentlich war es aber üblich, sie im Ofen zu backen, doch es gab Leute, die sich das nicht leisten konnten. Wenn das also nicht ging, dann konnte man sie auch zu Hause zubereiten. Nur musste das Wasser ganz schwach kochen, und danach ... doch sie konnten sie oben nicht knusprig werden lassen.

summary: Quantities (weight, count, jarful), material/source m-, and purpose l- are productive predicates; retain static or attained readings as context requires, without new numerical, preparation or serving senses.
Birth extends to domestic animals, with offspring as zero-marked subject and dams expressed with l-, or maternal source m-. Do not derive Detransitive morphology from German translations.
Comparative spousal relationship can involve transformed animal protagonists; no new lexical sense.
Location includes bodily injury on a person, strength in animals (b-), and mention in the Gospel (b-). These differ from l-suffix possession 6b.
hawi bepežən also has a human subject; absence of sound after a shot does not by itself assert death.
Explicit elapsed-from d-clause can replace the dative time anchor; no change to inherited number.
Reflexive moro l-ruḥ- supplies precaution/self-care, extending the cared-for participant rather than adding a sense.
Material provenance m- (lime from stone; clothing from cotton) continues prior composition/source extension. Grain amounting to a load likewise remains numerical/result predication.
Dowele tre farxe extends the birth construction to birds; animal subject/parent does not change the construction or establish Detransitive.
Ritual/legal offices, deliberate brotherhood and assigned lookout function extend social-role predication beyond biological family.

Borrowed dost with ʕam describes friendship and ḏ̣ayfo s- describes the guest-host relationship. These remain productive social-role predications, not separate lexical senses or independently established fixed idioms.
Part act. hawiye and hawiṯo qualify postpartum ewes and a gazelle; animal mothers extend the same meaning as human Wöchnerin, without changing the box or creating Detransitive.
Moro l- care applies to birds guarding young and to humans tending horses; plural Imperativ with l ruḥayxu adds reflexive care. No Detransitive is established by German betreuen.
Loan mahčet plus genitive diḏi is a productive need/adjective predicate, comparable to maḥteǧ elsewhere; do not duplicate the noun ḥtəyaǧ l- as a new sense.

Hawili abre d aḥuno applies the birth-result construction to an aunt receiving a nephew, not only a biological parent. The text explicitly situates the new family member; no new kinship-acquisition sense.
A horn in the game is assigned the fictive role emi / i emo. The participant changes from human to game object; the relationship meaning remains and needs no technical sense.
Eyes on oneself extends the vigilance collocation to reflexive watchfulness/footing, beside attention to ripening fruit; no second numbered watch sense.

Bare personal hwy with l-beneficiary and an overnight time phrase requests shelter (96/302; compare 88/49 in the prior batch). Hosting is a contextual instance of care; whether moro is omitted remains open, so no separate lexical host sense is accepted.

L-qul ʕayn- marks viewpoint for an asserted appearance that is later called mistaken. No independent hwy seem sense follows from the edition's erscheint; the viewpoint phrase supplies the evidential perspective.
